Decisions are Day 41's stored wake bits (46 cameras, first 1800 frames).
Target height is the tallest moving visible GT box; boxes of loaded Transporters and the Warehouse_019 stacker include their payload.
The Kubric-measured envelope is NOT used to classify any frame here.
No timing, CPU or latency figure is measured or reported (Day 19).

definitions.event_frame: post-warmup frame where >=1 entity moves in the world and has a visible box on this camera
definitions.target_height: tallest visible box among moving entities, native px
definitions.miss: wake_next False on an event frame

day41_below_envelope_question.note: The 1,581 are by construction frames the full-resolution gate woke on and the 320x180 gate did not; the question that matters is the whole below-envelope population, reported above.

meaning.ABOVE_ENVELOPE: a GT event the 320x180 gate slept through and full res caught (counted in the 320x180 miss_cost)
meaning.BELOW_ENVELOPE: GT motion visible but below the measured envelope (not a defect either way)
meaning.NOT_OBSERVABLE: GT motion with no visible box on this camera
meaning.NO_MOTION: no resolvable GT motion: a full-res wake on nothing
meaning.IN_WARMUP: first frames, not scored by either gate's scorecard
